FULL TEXT:
TAMILNADU FOREST DEPARTMENT
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for one post of Junior Research Fellow
(JRF) on contractual basis in Hassanur Division of Tamil Nadu Forest Department. A model
Application form is given below.
The received applications will be scrutinized, finalized, and selected applicants will be called
for interview before final selection.
SI. No. Post Position Educational and other qualifications
1. Junior
Research
Fellow
(JRF)
1 (one) • Bachelor’s Degree with a minimum of 55% marks in Wildlife
Science, Wildlife Biology, Forestry, Ecology, Environmental Science,
Zoology, Life Sciences, or Allied Disciplines from a recognized
University/Institute.
• Minimum 1 Year Experience in ArcGIS Software or Related GIS
Applications.

Notes:
1. Candidates with knowledge of local language, topography of the area and local cultural
background and professional experience will be preferred.
2. Weightage shall be given to those who have exposure in Forest Department activities
commensurate with their qualification, professional experience, and overall capability in relevant
field.
3. The candidates to be engaged shall be selected on the basis of merit, offer letters shall be sent
to the selected candidates through Registered post / Speed Post / Courier.
4. The selected candidates, shall produce physical fitness certificate from an Authorized Medical
Attendant not below the rank of Civil Assistant Surgeon.
Application form should be sent to the
following address.
Office of the Deputy Director,
Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve,
Hassanur Division,
Hassanur – 638 401.
